subject: a golden ribbon wall following a narrow teal water channel
art_direction: 金色带状墙沿青水道折转，白色平台和浅天空间形成流畅原创建筑景观。
visible_description: 金色带状墙沿青水道折转，白色平台和浅天空间形成流畅原创建筑景观。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a golden ribbon wall following a narrow teal water channel. The ribbon makes two broad turns in the lower scene, with one edge dipping toward the water. Use pale stone platforms on either side and simple reflections in the channel. The upper fifth remains a quiet ivory-blue sky. Keep seams minimal and omit plants, signs, or decorative lighting. Use refined geometric landscape painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
